entries: Worktrees also use saved "always allow" answers from the main checkout, so you are not asked again for a tool you already allowed there. Set `[features] worktree_inherits_main_approvals = false` to turn this off; the main checkout "never allow" answers apply either way
Prompt suggestions follow vim mode: with `[ui].vim_mode` on, `Tab` moves focus to the scrollback instead of accepting the suggestion. `→` or `Ctrl+→` accepts a suggestion, and `Esc` dismisses it
Headless `grok -p` runs exit when their work is done instead of hanging when a background task or subagent finishes and its output is read in the same turn
The theme picker in Settings restores your previous theme when you leave it any way other than `Enter`, as `/theme` already does
Quitting a session with hooks configured is faster
`/theme` restores your previous theme when you leave the picker any way other than `Enter`, such as `Esc`, `Ctrl+U`, `Tab` then `Esc`, or opening Settings or the dashboard

Selected and highlighted rows stay readable on every theme because reverse-video text is never dimmed. This fixes faint descriptions in selected menu rows on the `terminal` theme in terminals such as Kitty
`@` file completion shows results faster after you type
`/resume` search finds sessions from other folders, tolerates typos, and also matches the commands, file paths, and replies in a session
`--permission-mode plan` starts the session in plan mode, as documented, instead of the default mode
The dashboard `Ctrl+L` folder picker lists up to 50 recent folders instead of 10
`grok --help` gives each command and option a one-line summary, and `grok help -h` and `grok help --help` print help for the help command itself instead of an error
`/resume` search keeps a single typed character literal and matches each typed word at the start of a word, so `log fix` no longer matches "Blog prefix cleanup"
Any value of `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING`, including `0` and `false`, turns telemetry and crash reports off
Untrusted folders run only managed hooks from your organization. User, project, plugin, and agent hooks wait until you trust the folder. Headless sessions treat user hooks as trusted
Worktree names typed with `Ctrl+W` keep Unicode letters such as `café`, and a name or ref that starts with `-` is refused
Auto mode runs a shell command without review only when every command in it matches an allowlist entry; anything else asks first. Permission rules read each word the way bash passes it to the program
`/resume` loads older sessions when you reach the last row, and shows how many sessions are loaded
Auto mode runs `make --version`, `cmake --version`, and `just --version` without asking
HTTP connections, including remote MCP servers, accept gzip, brotli, zstd, and deflate compressed responses
Plugin install suggestions above the prompt are off when `disable_plugins = true` is set
New worktrees keep tracked files that match `.gitignore`, and leave out files excluded only by `.git/info/exclude` or `core.excludesFile`
A new session that fails to start puts what you typed back in the prompt you return to, instead of losing it
Web search works from the first turn of a session, and in subagents, when the search model signs in through an external auth provider
`grok -w`, `grok worktree create`, worktree forks, and subagent worktrees refuse up front with the sandbox refusal message when the sandbox profile does not allow creating worktrees
Worktree options are hidden in `/fork`, `/new`, and the Welcome screen when the sandbox profile does not allow creating worktrees
A worktree name you type that is already taken is refused instead of getting a numbered suffix, and a name whose folder you deleted by hand can be used again
Grok on macOS without a GUI session, such as over SSH, no longer hangs on its first modifier-key check
Custom models on the Responses API keep the turn going when a web search call starts without an action
Shell commands run correctly on zsh when your startup files alias `grep` or replace `run-help`
Voice dictation preview grows the prompt as you speak and keeps the newest words in view

Memory always uses the concise `MEMORY.md` index of topic titles and paths, and `/memory` lists topics by how often Grok reads them. The `[memory_v2] compact_index_enabled` setting no longer has an effect

Rex terminal support reports each open session and each running subagent as its own record, so Rex shows what each one is doing. Set `children = false` under `[ui.notifications.program_status]` to report only the main status
`grok worktree list` and `grok worktree show` mark a worktree whose folder is missing or whose source repository moved, with a hint on how to repair it
Command hooks accept an `args` list: Grok runs `command` as one program with those arguments and no shell, and fills hook variables such as `$GROK_SESSION_ID` in each argument
Plan reviews that open while you are typing keep your text in the review notes, so a typed letter no longer triggers a plan shortcut such as approve
Plan reviews at the end of a turn wait until you close an open `/feedback` dialog, question, tool prompt, or queued prompt edit
`grok -w` and `Ctrl+W` explain that no worktree was made when you run them outside a git repository
`/fork` keeps the model and effort from the parent session when Grok was started with `-m` or `--effort`
Custom models on Chat Completions endpoints no longer fail turns with a tool schema error when MCP servers are connected
Workflow run views hide live status text for each agent on narrower terminals, so agent names are no longer cut off

Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success
Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`
Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer
CLI commands such as `grok models`, `grok sessions` and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early, such as when piped to `head`, or when the output device is full
`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式等待背景工作接續對話，逾時中斷改回傳錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits for background follow-up turns and exits with error on timeout

body.zh-TW: 當你寫腳本透過指令列自動處理任務時，最怕背景工作還沒做完程式就提早離場。使用 `grok -p` 啟動無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）時，若已完成的背景工作觸發了接續對話，現在會耐心等待該輪對話結束後才退出。⟦如同自助洗衣機的運轉流程，以前主行程一結束就立刻切斷電源，不管追加的防皺運轉跑完了沒有；現在機器會等接續動作徹底收尾才關機，要是設定的時間上限強行中斷了未完工項，面板更會亮起錯誤紅燈而不是回報順利完成。⟧如果加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數且因逾時停止了待處理工作，程式結束時會回傳錯誤代碼，不再誤報為成功執行。
body.en: When scripting automated tasks through the command line, the biggest risk is a process exiting prematurely before background work finishes. When launching headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal screen) with `grok -p`, if completed background tasks trigger follow-up conversation turns, the runner now waits patiently for that turn to conclude before exiting. ⟦Like the cycle of a laundromat washing machine, the power previously cut off the moment the main cycle finished, regardless of whether the extra anti-wrinkle cycle had completed; now the machine shuts down only after follow-up actions wrap up completely, and if a configured time limit forcibly stops unfinished work, the panel flashes a red error light instead of reporting a successful run.⟧ If you provide the `--background-wait-timeout` option and pending work is stopped due to a timeout, the program now exits with an error code instead of falsely reporting success.

items.original: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success

title.zh-TW: 儀表板冷啟動恢復工作階段，保持浮層開啟並支援按鍵返回
title.en: Dashboard cold boot resumes sessions while keeping popover open with keyboard back navigation

body.zh-TW: 你在儀表板翻找過去的歷史紀錄時，可能會想先點進某個舊存檔看看進度。在儀表板浮層中針對未預載的存檔執行冷啟動 `/resume` 時，介面現在會讓浮動面板保持附著開啟。⟦彷彿在電子導覽機前點選歷史路徑，以前只要觸控未預載的深層檔案，選單面板就會冷不防關閉脫離，讓人想反悔返回都無從按起；現在清單畫面會持續固定在視野中，隨時都能按上一頁安全退回。⟧如此一來，載入舊工作階段時不會丟失操作畫面，你可以隨時按下向左方向鍵（Left）或 `Ctrl+\` 順利退出，返回原本的清單繼續瀏覽。
body.en: When browsing past history in the dashboard, you might want to open an older saved state to inspect its progress. Triggering a cold `/resume` on an unloaded session from the dashboard popover now keeps the floating panel open and attached. ⟦At a digital directory kiosk, tapping an unloaded deep record previously caused the menu panel to snap shut and detach unexpectedly, leaving no way to step back; now the list display stays anchored in view so you can safely return at any moment.⟧ This way, you never lose your context when loading an older session, and you can press the Left arrow key (Left) or `Ctrl+\` at any time to exit cleanly and return to the list.

items.original: Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`

title.zh-TW: 選取帶參數斜線指令按 Enter 直接執行，不再殘留空格
title.en: Selecting slash commands with arguments and pressing Enter executes immediately without trailing spaces

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用斜線指令時，大家常會透過選單挑選想跑的動作。當你在提示詞撰寫區反白選取帶有可選參數的斜線指令並按下 Enter 鍵時，現在會立刻執行該指令。以前輸入框（composer，撰寫提示詞的文字區）只會在指令後面留下一格多餘的空格，停在原地等待你再次確認。⟦好比在車載導航螢幕上選取附帶途經點的路線，以前按下確認鈕，畫面只會在輸入欄末端留下一格空白等候；現在一按便直接開始指引，不再卡在輸入框等待多餘的操作。⟧這樣不必在選好指令後還得手動多敲一次鍵，命令一選定就能順暢送出。
body.en: When using slash commands in the terminal input box, users often pick actions from the menu. Selecting a slash command with optional arguments in the prompt area and pressing Enter now executes that command immediately. Previously, the composer (the text area for writing prompts) only appended an extra space after the command, sitting idle while waiting for your confirmation. ⟦On an in-car navigation screen, selecting a route with waypoints and hitting confirm previously only left a blank space at the end of the input field; now a single press starts guidance immediately instead of stalling for redundant input.⟧ You no longer need to press an extra key manually after choosing a command, allowing selected actions to submit smoothly.

items.original: Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer

title.zh-TW: 多項 CLI 指令支援管道提早關閉與串流限制，避免輸出異常崩潰
title.en: Multiple CLI commands handle early pipe closures and stream limits without crashing

body.zh-TW: 平時在終端機串接多道指令過濾資料時，下游工具提早結束往往會引發非預期的中斷。包含 `grok models`、列出工作階段的 `grok sessions` 與 `grok export` 等指令，當輸出管道提早關閉（例如串接 `head` 只取前幾行）或輸出裝置已滿時，現在都不再發生當機。⟦就像工廠輸送帶上的分裝包裝線，以前只要下游集貨箱裝滿或接收閘門提早關閉，傳送機械便會當場卡死並引發整條產線警報；現在機台一旦察覺出口無法收件，就會平順停止輸出並安穩關機。⟧`grok update` 與 `grok login` 兩項指令在標準輸出（stdout）或標準錯誤關閉且無法寫入時，現在同樣能安全結束，確保批次腳本不再因串流截斷而崩潰。
body.en: When piping multiple commands in the terminal to filter data, a downstream tool exiting early often triggers unexpected disruptions. Commands including `grok models`, `grok sessions` for listing sessions, and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early (such as when piped into `head` for the first few lines) or when the output device fills up. ⟦In a factory conveyor packaging line, if a downstream collection bin filled up or a receiving gate closed early, the transport machinery previously jammed on the spot and triggered plant-wide alarms; now the equipment halts output smoothly and shuts down safely as soon as it detects that the exit cannot accept packages.⟧ `grok update` and `grok login` now also exit safely when standard output (stdout) or standard error is closed and unwritable, ensuring batch scripts no longer crash due to truncated streams.

items.original:
CLI commands such as `grok models`, `grok sessions` and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early, such as when piped to `head`, or when the output device is full
`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

entries: Resume picker finds sessions whose titles contain every word you type, in any order
`/resume <id or name>` opens the session directly when the ID or title matches exactly one session, instead of always opening the picker
Dashboard peek text can be selected by dragging over it with the mouse, and the selection is copied to the clipboard when you release
Workflow run views scroll toward newer agents when you wheel down the agent roster, instead of snapping back
Hook spawn failures on Windows name the program that failed to start, such as PowerShell or Git Bash, instead of blaming the hook script

title.zh-TW: /resume 精確比對單一工作階段直接開啟，選單支援任意詞序搜尋
title.en: /resume Directly Resumes an Exact Single-Session Match and Supports Any-Word-Order Search in the Picker

body.zh-TW: 當你累積了大量對話紀錄想重新接續進度時，不必再忍受死板的關鍵字順序或多餘的確認步驟。⟦翻找辦公室抽屜裡的專案夾時，以前封面標題上的單字順序只要顛倒就翻不出來，就算報出唯一編號也非得拉開整個清單；現在只要寫齊關鍵字無論順序都能對應，代碼剛好只吻合一份時更能直接抽取出夾。⟧現在在終端機輸入 `/resume <id or name>` 時，只要指定的 ID 或標題剛好只吻合單一工作階段，Grok Build 就會直接進入該工作階段，不再每次都強制彈出挑選器讓你多點一次。如果呼叫挑選器手動尋找，只要輸入的內容包含標題中的每一個單字，無論先後順序為何，挑選器都能精確列出符合的工作階段。
body.en: When you have accumulated a large conversation history and want to resume progress, you no longer have to endure rigid keyword ordering or redundant confirmation steps. ⟦Picture someone searching for a project folder in an office drawer. Previously, if the word order on the cover was reversed, it could not be found, and reciting a unique number still required opening the entire list. Now, entering all keywords matches regardless of sequence, and matching exactly one code lets you pull the folder straight out.⟧ Now when you enter `/resume <id or name>` in the terminal, as long as the specified ID or title matches exactly one session, Grok Build directly enters that session instead of forcing a picker popup every time for an extra click. If you bring up the picker to search manually, the picker accurately lists matching sessions as long as your input includes every word in the title, regardless of their order.

items.original:
Resume picker finds sessions whose titles contain every word you type, in any order
`/resume <id or name>` opens the session directly when the ID or title matches exactly one session, instead of always opening the picker

title.zh-TW: 儀表板預覽文字支援滑鼠拖曳，放開即自動複製到剪貼簿
title.en: Dashboard Preview Text Supports Mouse Dragging, Automatically Copying to the Clipboard on Release

body.zh-TW: 想要從儀表板快速擷取一段預覽內容轉貼給同事時，現在不需要再按任何鍵盤快捷鍵。⟦拿著螢光筆在文件上劃記重點時，以前畫完標記還得手動按相機快門留底；現在筆尖劃過文字並在放開筆桿時，內容就自動傳送至隨身筆記。⟧在儀表板檢視預覽文字時，你可以直接按住滑鼠游標拖曳選取想要的字串。只要在選取完成後放開滑鼠按鍵，被標記的文字片段就會自動複製到剪貼簿。無論是需要摘錄報錯內容還是比對執行結果，拖曳選取後就能直接切換到其他對話視窗貼上，省下反白後還要按鍵複製的瑣碎手續。
body.en: When you want to quickly grab preview content from the dashboard to paste for a colleague, you no longer need to press any keyboard shortcuts. ⟦Imagine marking highlights on a document with a highlighter. Previously, after finishing the mark, you still had to press a camera shutter manually to keep a record; now, as the pen tip glides across the text and releases, the content is transmitted automatically to a pocket notebook.⟧ While viewing preview text on the dashboard, you can click and drag the mouse cursor to select the desired string. As soon as you release the mouse button after completing the selection, the marked text snippet is automatically copied to the clipboard. Whether you need to extract error details or compare execution results, you can paste directly into another chat window right after dragging to select, saving the tedious step of pressing keys to copy after highlighting.

items.original: Dashboard peek text can be selected by dragging over it with the mouse, and the selection is copied to the clipboard when you release

title.zh-TW: 工作流程檢視向下滾動名冊時，畫面持續朝較新代理人平順推進
title.en: Workflow View Smoothly Advances Toward Newer Agents When Scrolling Down the Roster

body.zh-TW: 追蹤多個代理人協同運作的工作流程時，檢視進度最怕視窗畫面不聽使喚。⟦順著排隊走道向前推動檢視鏡頭時，以前只要滾輪往下滾動，視野就冷不防被彈簧拉回起點；現在畫面會依循操作，順暢朝著後方新加入的成員推進。⟧在工作流程的執行檢視畫面中，當你在代理人名冊上向下滾動滑鼠滾輪時，畫面現在會順著操作方向持續朝向較新的代理人捲動，而不是突然彈回原處。這讓你在依序盤點每個代理人的最新執行進度時，視野能夠一路平穩跟隨，不必反覆重新尋找焦點。
body.en: When tracking a workflow where multiple agents collaborate, the biggest frustration when checking progress is an uncooperative viewport. ⟦Think of tracking an inspection camera forward along a queue corridor. Previously, whenever the scroll wheel moved downward, the view was abruptly pulled back to the starting point like a spring; now, the frame follows the action, smoothly advancing toward newly joined members at the rear.⟧ In the workflow execution view, when you scroll down on the agent roster with the mouse wheel, the view now continuously scrolls toward newer agents in the direction of your movement, rather than snapping back to the origin. This allows your line of sight to smoothly follow along as you inspect each agent's latest execution progress in sequence, without having to repeatedly hunt for focus.

items.original: Workflow run views scroll toward newer agents when you wheel down the agent roster, instead of snapping back

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行掛鉤失敗時點名未啟動的程式，不再誤指指令碼出錯
title.en: Windows Identifies Unstarted Programs When Hook Execution Fails, Rather Than Blaming the Script

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下使用掛鉤（在特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）除錯自動化流程時，最怕看到語意模糊的錯誤訊息。⟦呼叫外勤車隊出門執行任務時，以前只要外包貨車在門口無法發動，控制台卻只會回報派工單寫錯；現在通報會明確點名是哪一輛車發動失敗，不再冤枉原本寫好的任務清單。⟧在 Windows 系統中若掛鉤產生行程失敗，終端機現在會直接點名究竟是哪個外部程式無法啟動，例如具體標示出 PowerShell 或 Git Bash 發生錯誤，而不是怪罪掛鉤指令稿本身。面對這類問題時，你能立刻看出是環境缺少執行工具還是路徑設定遺漏，省下逐行檢查指令碼內容的時間。
body.en: When debugging automated workflows on Windows using hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), the worst experience is seeing ambiguous error messages. ⟦Dispatching a field fleet for a mission previously meant that whenever an outsourced truck failed to start at the gate, the control center only reported an error in the work order; now, the alert clearly names which vehicle failed to start without falsely blaming the original task list.⟧ If a hook fails to spawn a process on Windows, the terminal now directly names which external program failed to start, such as specifically indicating an error in PowerShell or Git Bash, rather than blaming the hook script itself. When confronting such issues, you can immediately tell whether the environment lacks an execution tool or is missing a path configuration, saving time spent inspecting the script line by line.

items.original: Hook spawn failures on Windows name the program that failed to start, such as PowerShell or Git Bash, instead of blaming the hook script

entries: `grok --resume <title>` lists matching sessions newest first with when each was last updated, and suggests similar titles when nothing matches
`Shift+Y` in the fullscreen markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor
`grok --resume <title>` with a title that matches no local session reports the miss right away instead of trying a remote restore and asking you to sign in
`Esc` on the first question in a session opened from the dashboard moves focus to the scrollback, as it does in a standalone session, instead of returning to the dashboard

title.zh-TW: grok --resume 依更新時間排序工作階段，找不到本機紀錄時即刻回報
title.en: grok --resume sorts sessions by update time and immediately reports when local records are missing

body.zh-TW:
當你累積了大量對話想重新接續先前的工作進度，只憑模糊印象輸入名稱往往難以精準定位。⟦如同在圖書館櫃檯查詢借閱紀錄，以前一旦館內找不到藏書，館方電腦便主動發起外館調閱並要求重新刷卡驗證；現在螢幕直接按最後更新時間由近到遠條列項目，若沒有相符紀錄還會提示相近名稱，找不到時立即告知結果。⟧

執行 `grok --resume <title>` 恢復對話時，列出的相符工作階段會依據最後更新時間由新到舊排序，並清楚附上各自的最近更新時間。要是輸入的名稱完全沒有符合的紀錄，命令列會主動推薦相似的標題供你挑選。

當指定的標題在本地電腦中完全不存在時，命令列現在會立即回報未找到，而不是嘗試發起遠端還原程序並要求你登入帳號。
body.en:
When you have accumulated many conversations and want to resume earlier progress, typing a name from vague memory often makes precise targeting difficult. ⟦Think of checking borrowing records at a library counter. Previously, whenever a book was missing from the collection, the computer initiated an interlibrary loan and required card reverification; now, the screen lists items from newest to oldest by last update time, suggests similar names if no record matches, and reports the result immediately when nothing is found.⟧

When running `grok --resume <title>` to resume a conversation, matching sessions are listed in order from newest to oldest based on their last update time, clearly displaying their respective recent update times. If the entered name has no matching records at all, the command line recommends similar titles for you to choose from.

When the specified title does not exist at all on the local machine, the command line now immediately reports that it was not found, instead of attempting to initiate a remote restore process and asking you to log in.

items.original:
`grok --resume <title>` lists matching sessions newest first with when each was last updated, and suggests similar titles when nothing matches
`grok --resume <title>` with a title that matches no local session reports the miss right away instead of trying a remote restore and asking you to sign in

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器按 Shift+Y 複製游標所在的程式碼區塊
title.en: Full-screen Markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor with Shift+Y

body.zh-TW:
閱讀長篇技術文件或檢視終端機輸出時，切換到全螢幕檢視器能讓排版更為乾淨，但想取用其中的範例段落往往需要額外步驟。⟦彷彿拿著手持掃描器在貨架間盤點，以前想記錄規格得拿出紙筆沿著邊界逐字謄寫，現在光點只要對準商品標籤扣下按鍵，整組資料便立刻收進隨身清單。⟧

在全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器中，現在只要將游標移動到目標程式碼上方，按下快捷鍵 `Shift+Y`，就會複製游標所在的整個程式碼區塊。如此一來，閱讀長篇文件時便能直接擷取所需的指令或程式碼片段，不必再特地動用滑鼠手動框選。
body.en:
When reading long technical documents or inspecting terminal output, switching to a full-screen viewer keeps the layout cleaner, but grabbing example passages often takes extra steps. ⟦Picture taking inventory among store shelves with a handheld scanner. Previously, recording specifications meant pulling out pen and paper to transcribe character by character along the margins; now, aiming the light beam at a product label and pressing a button instantly pulls the whole dataset into a portable list.⟧

In the full-screen Markdown viewer, moving the cursor over target code and pressing `Shift+Y` now copies the entire code block beneath the cursor. Reading long documents this way lets you capture needed commands or snippets directly without reaching for a mouse to highlight them manually.

items.original: `Shift+Y` in the fullscreen markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor

title.zh-TW: 從儀表板開啟工作階段時，按 Esc 聚焦回捲歷程而非退回儀表板
title.en: Pressing Esc focuses scrollback instead of returning to dashboard when opening a session

body.zh-TW:
從儀表板開啟特定工作階段準備輸入指令時，要是想先檢閱先前的上下文，直覺按鍵往往可能帶來非預期的畫面切換。⟦跟參觀特展展示台一樣，以前在互動導覽的第一道題目按下返回鍵，畫面會冷不防退回接待大廳；現在只會把檢視游標移到上方的過往解說板，與獨立參觀時的行為完全相同。⟧

以前從儀表板開啟工作階段後，若在第一個提問處按下 `Esc`，畫面會直接關閉並退回儀表板。現在按下 `Esc` 時，焦點會切換到上方儲存的回捲歷程（scrollback，可往上捲動查看歷史輸出的區域）。這樣的一致行為與直接在終端機啟動的獨立工作階段相同，避免你為了查看先前的對話而中斷手頭上的流程。
body.en:
When opening a session from the dashboard to enter commands, intuitive keystrokes can often trigger unexpected view switches if you want to inspect earlier context first. ⟦Like visiting a special exhibition booth, pressing back at the first question of an interactive guide used to kick you back to the reception hall without warning; now, it only shifts the viewing cursor up to the previous display board, behaving exactly like a self-guided tour.⟧

Previously, after opening a session from the dashboard, pressing `Esc` at the first prompt would close the view and return directly to the dashboard. Now, pressing `Esc` shifts focus to the saved scrollback (the buffer area for scrolling up to inspect past output). This consistent behavior matches standalone sessions started directly in the terminal, preventing interruptions to your workflow when you only want to review prior dialogue.

items.original: `Esc` on the first question in a session opened from the dashboard moves focus to the scrollback, as it does in a standalone session, instead of returning to the dashboard

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆內容保留原始定位字元，程式碼區塊標註語言與檔名
title.en: Copying responses preserves original tab characters, while code blocks label language and file names

body.zh-TW: 當你在對話結束後整理 Grok 生成的內容，想把程式碼或整段說明貼到自己的編輯器時，複製功能帶來了更乾淨的操作體驗。⟦如同在電子筆記中剪貼參考資料，標籤清楚標記出每段摘錄的來源格式，無論切換成精簡視窗還是全螢幕檢視，底部的操作列都能整齊排版，貼到其他文件時也保留了原本的段落縮排。⟧已完成的回覆中，每個程式碼區塊下方現在都會顯示 `[Copy]` 複製按鈕，並標明該段程式碼所屬的語言或檔案名稱。如果你在精簡模式與全螢幕模式之間切換，程式碼區塊、表格與圖表底部的複製列現在都能正確顯示，不會再出現版面錯位。複製整個程式碼區塊或整篇回覆時，內容會維持原有的定位字元（tab），不再被自動替換成空格。
body.en: When organizing Grok-generated content after a conversation to paste code or full explanations into your editor, the copy features deliver a cleaner workflow. ⟦Think of clipping reference notes into a digital notebook: tags clearly mark the source format of each excerpt, the bottom action bar stays neatly arranged whether switching between compact and full-screen views, and original paragraph indentations remain intact when pasted into other documents.⟧ In completed responses, every code block now displays a `[Copy]` button below it, labeling the language or file name for that code. If you switch between compact mode and full-screen mode, the copy bar at the bottom of code blocks, tables, and charts renders correctly without layout misalignment. When copying an entire code block or a full response, content preserves its original tab characters instead of being automatically replaced with spaces.

items.original:
`[Copy]` buttons appear under code blocks in finished replies, labeled with the language or file name of the code
Copy rows under code blocks, tables, and diagrams display correctly after switching between minimal and fullscreen modes
Copying a code block or a whole reply keeps its original tabs instead of turning them into spaces

title.zh-TW: PowerShell 掛鉤支援讀取輸入變數，回傳中斷指令確實終止對話
title.en: PowerShell hooks support reading input variables, reliably ending conversations on abort commands

body.zh-TW: 當你撰寫自動化指令來介入 AI 對話流程時，自訂掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在具備更穩定的執行彈性。⟦好比在自動化生產線設置檢驗站，感測器遇到非標準格式的進料時先亮黃燈警示並繼續運作，而當品檢員送出停機訊號時，輸送帶也能確實立刻停止。⟧過去在進階 PowerShell 行內掛鉤中，如果程式碼讀取了 `$input` 變數，整個掛鉤會直接失敗。現在它會印出警告訊息並維持執行。當掛鉤回傳 `continue: false` 時，AI 現在會依指示確實停止該輪對話，不再像以前那樣直接忽略中斷訊號。這確保了前置檢查未通過時，後續的推理動作不會擅自繼續進行。
body.en: When writing automated commands to intervene in AI conversation flows, custom hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) now offer more reliable execution flexibility. ⟦Picture an inspection station on an automated assembly line: sensors flash a yellow warning light and keep running when encountering non-standard feeds, while the conveyor belt reliably stops immediately when quality inspectors send an abort signal.⟧ Previously in advanced PowerShell inline hooks, if code read the `$input` variable, the entire hook failed outright. It now prints a warning message and continues executing. When a hook returns `continue: false`, the AI reliably stops that turn of conversation as instructed, rather than ignoring the abort signal as before. This ensures that subsequent reasoning steps will not proceed unauthorized if pre-checks fail.

items.original:
Advanced PowerShell inline hooks that read `$input` run with a warning instead of failing
Hooks that return `continue: false` stop the turn instead of being ignored

title.zh-TW: 儀表板空指令改顯示用法說明，預覽貼上支援 Esc 與換列取消
title.en: Dashboard empty commands now display usage instructions, while preview paste supports cancellation via Esc or switching rows

body.zh-TW: 在儀表板檢視專案或輸入指令時，介面現在能妥善防範誤觸所帶來的非預期動作。⟦彷彿操作精密儀器的控制面板，空按循環按鈕只會跳出使用教學而不會直接啟動新排程，若在準備貼上資料的中途切換選單或按下取消鍵，儀表板也會主動提示已中止任務，避免指令在背景默默送出。⟧在儀表板中，如果你輸入了 `/loop` 循環指令卻沒有附帶提示詞，現在只會顯示該指令的使用方法，不會再開啟一個新的工作階段（session）。當你在快速預覽視窗中等待貼上剪貼簿內容時，只要把焦點移動到其他資料列或按下 Esc 鍵，該筆待送出的回覆就會立刻取消，並跳出浮動通知告知狀態，不再滯留並於稍後意外送出。
body.en: When viewing projects or entering commands in the dashboard, the interface now properly guards against unintended actions caused by accidental triggers. ⟦A control panel on precision equipment provides a fitting parallel: pressing a loop button with no arguments only displays a tutorial rather than launching a fresh schedule, and switching menus or hitting cancel midway through pasting data prompts an alert that the task was aborted before commands can silently send in the background.⟧ In the dashboard, entering the `/loop` command without an accompanying prompt now only displays usage instructions for that command, instead of opening a new session. When waiting to paste clipboard content in the quick preview window, simply moving focus to another row or pressing the Esc key immediately cancels that pending response and triggers a toast notification with the status, rather than lingering to send unexpectedly later.

items.original:
Dashboard `/loop` without a prompt shows its usage instead of starting a new session
Dashboard peek replies waiting on a clipboard paste are canceled with a toast when you move the peek to another row or press Esc, instead of being sent later

title.zh-TW: `grok --resume` 支援任意分隔符，找舊工作階段不再需要精確符號
title.en: `grok --resume` supports arbitrary delimiters, eliminating the need for exact symbols when finding past sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續之前的對話進度，在終端機喚回舊的工作階段（session）時，標題搜尋不再要求字元完全一致。⟦就像在音樂播放器中搜尋歌名，以前只要把單字之間的空格打成連字號就找不到曲目，現在搜尋功能會自動忽略符號差異，隨手輸入片段詞彙就能立即找出收藏的歌曲。⟧現在執行 `grok --resume <title>` 時，指令會自動忽略標題單字之間的連接符號。即使原本的紀錄名稱是「Fix login bug」，你只要輸入 `grok --resume fix-login-bug`，甚至用底線分隔單字，都能順利找到並重啟該次工作階段。這省去了每次接續專案前，都得先翻找歷史紀錄確認精確標題大小寫與空格格式的麻煩。
body.en: When resuming past conversation progress and recalling old sessions in the terminal, title searches no longer demand character-for-character precision. ⟦Like searching for song titles in a music player, where typing a hyphen instead of a space between words once yielded no tracks, the search feature now ignores punctuation differences so entering word fragments immediately locates saved songs.⟧ Now when running `grok --resume <title>`, the command automatically ignores joining symbols between title words. Even if the original recorded name is "Fix login bug", typing `grok --resume fix-login-bug` or separating words with underscores will successfully locate and restart that session. This saves the hassle of digging through history before resuming a project just to confirm exact title casing and spacing.

items.original: `grok --resume <title>` matches a title whatever separates its words, so `fix-login-bug` finds "Fix login bug"

title.zh-TW: `grok worktree rm` 修正錯誤提示，無法強制移除時不再建議 `-f`
title.en: `grok worktree rm` fixes error hints, no longer suggesting `-f` when force removal is impossible

body.zh-TW: 當你使用指令清理專案工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，終端機不再給出無效的排錯建議。⟦正如前往快遞櫃檯寄送物品，如果物件本身因體積超標而無法收件，人員便不會再建議你改買特快專遞方案，避免你多跑一趟流程卻依然被退件。⟧過去執行 `grok worktree rm` 移除工作樹時，如果遇到了受保護或無法直接刪除的狀態，錯誤訊息往往會建議加上 `-f` 參數強制移除；但實際上即便你真的補上 `-f`，指令仍然會拒絕刪除該工作樹。現在這項不實用的提示已經移除，只有在 `-f` 確實能發揮強制刪除效果時，終端機才會提示該選項。
body.en: When using commands to clean up project worktrees (a Git feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project), the terminal no longer offers ineffective troubleshooting advice. ⟦Just as visiting a courier counter to ship a package means staff will not suggest switching to express delivery if an oversized parcel cannot be accepted at all, you are spared an extra trip that still ends in rejection.⟧ Previously, when running `grok worktree rm` to remove a worktree that was protected or could not be directly deleted, error messages often recommended adding the `-f` flag for force removal. In reality, even if you supplied `-f`, the command still refused to delete the worktree. This unhelpful hint has now been removed, and the terminal suggests the option only when `-f` can genuinely carry out a forced deletion.

items.original: `grok worktree rm` no longer suggests `-f` for a worktree that `-f` would also refuse to remove

entries: Minor bug fixes

title.zh-TW: Grok Build 1.0.58 的小錯誤修正
title.en: Minor Bug Fixes in Grok Build 1.0.58

body.zh-TW: 平時透過 Grok Build 執行開發任務時，偶爾會碰上非預期的零星錯誤干擾操作節奏。⟦就像定期把自行車牽去車行檢修，以前踩踏時零組件偶爾發出細碎雜音，現在技師逐一旋緊微小螺絲，上路騎乘便順暢安心。⟧新推出的 1.0.58 版本集中修復了各處零星異常。如果你平常用 Grok Build 跑開發任務，升級到 1.0.58 就會拿到這批修正。這版收錄了一批小錯誤修正，官方沒有逐條列出內容。
body.en: When executing development tasks through Grok Build, unexpected sporadic errors occasionally disrupt your workflow rhythm. ⟦Think of taking a bicycle to a repair shop for routine maintenance: components once produced faint rattling noises while pedaling, but a mechanic now tightens each tiny screw so riding feels smooth and secure.⟧ The newly released version 1.0.58 centrally fixes scattered anomalies across the board. If you regularly run development tasks with Grok Build, upgrading to 1.0.58 will deliver these fixes. This release includes a batch of minor bug fixes, though the official changelog does not enumerate the details item by item.
